$comment: Overlay ports for the two dependencies that have no vcpkg port of their own: rapidyenc (SIMD yEnc) and par2-turbo (PAR2 verify/repair). The CMake build can FetchContent both, but the hand-maintained src/eMuleQt.sln resolves everything from src/vcpkg_installed/, so without these the MSBuild build silently loses SIMD yEnc decoding and all PAR2 support. Having them here also stops the Windows CI job rebuilding them from source on every run.
